description.value: Rens Cafe & Bistro is a Thai fusion restaurant on Burnaby's Hastings Street, serving modern takes on Thai classics such as Pad Thai, Hotpot, and Crispy Soft Shell Crab alongside robot pour-over coffee. The restaurant offers a full catering and private event service for groups of all sizes. Notably, it accepts Bitcoin Lightning Network payments — one of the few restaurants in BC to do so.

The OSM name 'Rens Cafe' differs from the website's 'Rens Cafe & Bistro'.
